assets.name: prometheum
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Asset: Minecraft block ore overlay texture. Edit target is the attached original TAIGA prometheum ore 16x16 PNG. Extract and modernize ONLY its mineral inclusions. Remove ALL background stone into real transparent alpha. Natural asymmetrical small clusters scattered over the square tile with at least 55% transparent space, not one central item icon, no decorative frame. This transparent mineral layer will be laid onto the matching vanilla block texture by a Minecraft block model.
